Van Geene, L., Van Dam, D. and Ilhan, B. (2024). Manufacturing Industry Decarbonisation Data Exchange Network - The database (version 0.4). The Hague: PBL Netherlands Environmental Assessment Agency and TNO Energy Transition Studies. Database file version 0.4a (November 2024, erratum January 2025).

Generated by midden-extract.py from the TC (Technology Characteristics) sheet: one example per technology card (541), process = the plant section of the first plant configuration using the card, with the MIDDEN sector report behind it. Quantities are per unit of capacity per year, so for kt capacities TJ/kt = GJ/t and kt/kt = t/t; for MW and TJ capacities, flows and emissions are divided by the main energy output. SEC (kt capacities) and efficiency (MW capacities) are DERIVED as sums of the TJ inputs. Capex and O&M in MEUR<year> per unit capacity are x1000 to EUR/t-per-yr or EUR/kW(-yr). Capex cost basis comes from the card comment where stated (additional/retrofit/substitution = incremental, set aside until a host cost is paired; nine hand-checked overrides); otherwise installed is ASSUMED (modeller ruling 2026-09-29). Flows are loaded only for MIDDEN commodities mapped to the commodity vocabulary with a matching unit; every input and output is kept as printed in _io-as-printed.csv. Refurbishment capex, F-gases and values on other capacity units are in _other-values.csv. The MIDDEN sector reports are the documentation of these cards and are not extracted separately (modeller ruling 2026-09-29); the database is the source.

(1) No cost basis is stated for investment costs (database paper p.9 says only that they are in MEUR per unit of capacity). (2) The heating-value basis of energy flows (TJ) is not stated; Dutch energy statistics use the lower heating value, so fuel inputs, efficiencies and SEC may be on LHV - loaded as not stated. (3) Some cards carry plant-specific scaling (e.g. costs scaled with exponent 0.67-0.7 to the plant size). (4) Many cards repeat the same values across plants; the pool-once rule counts each figure once per archetype. (5) Plant sections are misaligned for several Shell Pernis refinery configurations (e.g. PCD1212, PCD1247-1254); the extractor takes the section most cards use. (6) Hydrogen and some fuels are given in kt rather than TJ and are not converted; they stay in _io-as-printed.csv.
